presets.label: Perfect world
presets.caption: Nominal model, no faults: the mouse tracks the profile and lands on the cell centre.

presets.label: Friction: why 93°
presets.caption: A: a plant with no gearbox friction, so the feedforward's kS over-drives the spin to 93°. B: friction modelled, it lands on 90°.

presets.label: Floor seam fools the encoders
presets.caption: Each tyre rolls over a raised tile joint at 900 mm and counts 20 mm the body never travels, so B stops ~12 mm short.

presets.label: Gyro drift
presets.caption: A 5 °/s gyro bias: heading hold trusts the IMU, so B steers the real mouse ~9° off the straight while the IMU thinks it is holding.

presets.label: Low battery
presets.caption: At 5.0 V the motors hit the battery ceiling: B lags the profile, then overshoots the stop and veers.

presets.label: Slippery floor
presets.caption: Grip cut to μ 0.15 with 8 slip events/s per wheel: B's tyres skid through the smooth turn and it comes out ~12° short.
